comparison.objective: Carry a carton of cans whose untaped bottom flaps can open unless continuously supported from below.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain underside support and coordinated grasp during transport while managing a gravity-driven containment failure mode.
comparison.success_condition: Deliver the carton and cans without flap opening, can loss, spill, or unsafe unsupported carrying, then place it stably.
comparison.reason: This tests continuous bimanual support of a failure-prone container during transport, with no adjustment, tool insertion, locking, or dynamic parameter identification. Record thresholds are largely outcome-based, but that missing precision does not imply overlap. Candidate dynamic acceptance thresholds are also partly undeclared.
